patthana23.23:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā asaṃkiliṭṭha saṃkilesiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā cha, na saṃkiliṭṭha
patthana23.23:2.1: saṃkilesikaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saṃkiliṭṭha saṃkilesiko akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na saṃkiliṭṭha
patthana23.23:3.1: saṃkilesikaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭha saṃkilesiko abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā cha. na savitakkasavicāraṃ na kusalaṃ
